bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。 前提・単位・境界 区間[0,1]、Gauss次数8/16/32/64/128、公差10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹です。Lorentz幅.1/.03/.01、相殺係数0/2¹²/2²⁴/2³⁶を固定します。零積分の相対条件数は未定義としてnullで保存します。 編集上の補足 適応推定値や計算間の一致は任意の被積分関数の厳密誤差上界ではありません。相殺時の絶対誤差と相対誤差、未検出の局所構造、評価予算を分けて記録します。 採用した計算法 Golub–Welschの節点・重みと、局所差/15を用いる適応Simpsonを実装します。端点ではx=t²変換を別対照とし、狭いbumpには既知支持区間を分割した対照を用意します。これは一般的な自動救済機構ではありません。 Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK. Assumptions, units and boundaries Use[0,1], Gauss orders8/16/32/64/128 and tolerances10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹. Lorentz widths are.1/.03/.01; cancellation scales are0/2¹²/2²⁴/2³⁶. A zero integral has undefined relative condition, stored as null. Editorial clarification An adaptive estimate or agreement between calculations is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary integrands. Distinguish absolute and relative error under cancellation, unresolved local structure and evaluation budgets. Adopted numerical method Implement Golub–Welsch nodes/weights and adaptive Simpson with a local difference/15 estimate. Passing the blind-spot control does not mean accurate integration. Direct square-root integration may honestly terminate at its depth budget.
